title: Marry Me Salad
description: A simple and life-changing lettuce salad with lemon, garlic, olive oil, salt, pepper, and a splash of white vinegar.

ingredients.item: A little bit of olive oil
Salt, about a flat quarter's worth in your hand

steps: Combine shredded lettuce, lemon juice, olive oil, salt, grated garlic, pepper, and white vinegar.
Mix well to ensure all ingredients are incorporated.
notes:
Feel free to add peppers, feta cheese, or other toppings as desired.

Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/v/14M4LEWpzXG/

Nutrition: Serving 1 bowl · Calories Approximately 50 kcal per serving · Fat 3g · Saturated fat 0.5g · Unsaturated fat 2.5g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 0mg · Sodium 50mg · Carbs 5g · Fiber 1g · Sugar 1g · Protein 1g

healthy: Olive oil dressing is mostly unsaturated fat.
Lemon and garlic add flavor without sugar.
not_healthy: Iceberg lettuce is light on vitamins and fiber compared with darker greens.
A generous handful of salt makes it high in sodium.
